coordinates.origin: body center projected to Z=0 with swimming body above floor

concept.reason: Direct reference imagery and taxon-specific sources sufficient for original silhouette; no extra concept image.

scope: Original Coccosteus cuspidatus living reconstruction, informed by fossil ROM VP52664 photograph and MUSE head armor; SM H4494 syntype catalogue supports identity and historical names. Not a specimen scan.

scientific_limits.en: Tail soft-tissue outline, fin web margins, thickness, color and dimensions are inferred artistic estimates. Published 2024 reconstruction explicitly uses extant shark analogues for tail margins. 2025 paired-fin research warns against obsolete tiny ventrally placed pelvic fins; its indexed abstract excerpt was read, not unavailable full text.
scientific_limits.zh: 尾部软组织轮廓、鳍膜边缘、厚度、颜色和尺寸均为推断性的艺术估计。2024 年发表的复原明确借鉴现生鲨鱼来推断尾部边缘。2025 年的成对鳍研究提醒，不应沿用过时的、过小且置于腹侧的腹鳍复原；所阅读的是检索索引中的摘要节选，并非未能取得的全文。

taxon_scope: Coccosteus cuspidatus; historical Coccosteus decipiens/pusillus names checked

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic adult envelope guided approximately by ROM figure scale; not a precise specimen measurement or maximum-size claim.

shape_requirements: Original compact jointed head armor on a long lightly armored swimming body must remain visible; not an all-armored box or a scaled Dunkleosteus.
Readable low head shield and short thoracic armor with a cranio-thoracic articulation break; taper into flexible long post-thoracic trunk and tail.
Paired pectoral and pelvic fins, dorsal fin and unequal caudal lobes supported by fossil/reconstruction context. Fin outlines are conservative estimates, not copied publication geometry.
Moderate fish mouth and distinct eyes; no enormous Dunkleosteus blades, needle jaws, horns or dense false armor on the rear body.
construction_notes: Front armor seams should be shallow real geometry/facet boundaries; avoid copying fracture cracks from the MUSE fossil as anatomical sutures.
Keep pelvic fins as substantial lateral paired structures posterior to thoracic shield, not tiny belly triangles copied mechanically from older reconstructions. Exact web shape remains inferred.
Tail should be long enough for original gate but not eel-like; fossil ROM52664 supports tapering post-thoracic body, published skin outline is reconstructed.
Muted gray olive palette and still swimming pose are original art choices; no water scene, base or animation needed.

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: compact jointed head armor on a long lightly armored swimming body. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：长而轻甲游泳身体前端的紧凑关节头甲。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block compact jointed head armor on a long lightly armored swimming body with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织长而轻甲游泳身体前端的紧凑关节头甲；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded
gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
